game.title: Shadow of the Colossus
game.blurb: Action adventure in which Wander must fell sixteen colossi, from Sony Interactive Entertainment, released 2011-09-22 on PlayStation 3 (first a PlayStation 2 game). RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action. Chapter order follows the StrategyWiki walkthrough (CC BY-SA 4.0), grouped four colossi at a time.

chapters.title: Colossi 1 to 4
chapters.summary: The first four colossi: Valus, Quadratus, Gaius and Phaedra.

chapters.title: Colossi 5 to 8
chapters.summary: The next four: Avion, Barba, Hydrus and Kuromori.

chapters.title: Colossi 13 to 16 and the Ending
chapters.summary: Phalanx, Cenobia, Argus and the final colossus, Malus. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Extras
chapters.summary: Optional content after the story, as listed on the StrategyWiki Extras page.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki (CC BY-SA 4.0) has the guide under "Shadow of the Colossus" at completion stage 3, in categories for PlayStation 2, 3 and 4. All 16 colossus pages are written (about 1,900 to 6,200 characters each, about 56,000 in all), plus "Extras" (about 5,300), "Controls" (about 2,900) and a short "Walkthrough" index (about 1,100); "Gameplay" is linked but not created. Chapters follow its contents order, four colossi to a chapter; the colossus names (Valus, Quadratus and so on) are StrategyWiki page names, while Fandom names them "Colossus I" to "Colossus XVI". No text was copied. teamico.fandom.com answers the API, with about 216 linked pages, including "Agro", "Dormin", "Arch Bridge Plain" and "Colossus Arenas"; names only were looked at. RAWG lists this as the 2011 PlayStation 3 entry ("Shadow of the Colossus (2011)", slug shadow-of-the-colossus), separate from the 2005 original and the 2018 remake. RAWG lists a playtime of only 3 hours.
